name: Port Sable Industrial
description: Rusted trade station built into a canyon asteroid. Corrugated metal, exposed pipes, neon signage, grime.

metal_plate.label: Metal Plate
metal_plate.desc: Riveted steel deck plating, worn smooth by decades of boot traffic.

metal_grate.label: Metal Grate
metal_grate.desc: Open grate flooring. You can see the conduit bundles underneath.

concrete.label: Concrete
concrete.desc: Poured asteroid-dust concrete, cracked at the seams.

stained.label: Stained Metal
stained.desc: Dark stains and oil patches. Nobody cleans this side of the dock.

civic_tile.label: Civic Tile
civic_tile.desc: Official station floor tile. Still clean. Somehow.

void.label: Void/Space
void.desc: Open space between sections. Cold and honest about it.

hull_plate.label: Hull Plate
hull_plate.desc: Thick outer hull plating, bolted and welded.

corrugated.label: Corrugated
corrugated.desc: Corrugated metal dividers, cheap and effective.

pipe_bundle.label: Pipe Bundle
pipe_bundle.desc: A dense cluster of pipes, conduits, and ductwork forming a wall.

rock.label: Rock/Asteroid
rock.desc: Raw asteroid rock, reinforced with spray-foam seal.

civic_block.label: Civic Block
civic_block.desc: Poured authority-issue concrete with worn civic markings.

barrel.label: Barrel
barrel.desc: A sealed industrial drum. Could be fuel, waste, or something else.

crate.label: Crate
crate.desc: A stamped cargo crate. Marked with a destination nobody can read anymore.

terminal.label: Terminal
terminal.desc: A wall-mounted data terminal. Screen flickers between info and static.

pipe_vent.label: Pipe Vent
pipe_vent.desc: A large steam vent. Hisses periodically.

cable_bundle.label: Cable Bundle
cable_bundle.desc: Bundles of power and data cables zip-tied to the wall.

bunk.label: Bunk
bunk.desc: A fold-down bunk, stained and utilitarian.

counter.label: Counter/Bar
counter.desc: A long service counter, scratched and worn.

locker.label: Locker
locker.desc: A bolted storage locker with a cheap padlock.

sign_neon.label: Neon Sign
sign_neon.desc: A hand-wired neon sign. Half the letters still work.

debris.label: Debris
debris.desc: Scattered scrap, broken components, and general station grime.

chem_tank.label: Chem Tank
chem_tank.desc: A pressurized chemical tank, labeled with faded hazard marks.

steam_vent.label: Steam Vent
steam_vent.desc: Periodic steam release from overhead ductwork.

neon_glow.label: Neon Glow
neon_glow.desc: Ambient neon light bleed from nearby signage.

flicker.label: Flickering Light
flicker.desc: An overhead light cycling between dim and functional.

haze.label: Smoke Haze
haze.desc: Thin atmospheric haze, part chemical, part cigarette.

drip.label: Water Drip
drip.desc: A slow drip from a ceiling seal. The station is not watertight.

sparks.label: Sparks
sparks.desc: Occasional electrical sparks from damaged conduit.

red_light.label: Red Warning Light
red_light.desc: A pulsing red warning light in restricted zones.

worn_number.label: Worn Number
worn_number.desc: A faded berth or section number stenciled on the floor.

civic_stripe.label: Civic Stripe
civic_stripe.desc: An authority yellow stripe marking jurisdiction.

blood_stain.label: Blood Stain
blood_stain.desc: Something happened here. Nobody filed a report.

graffiti.label: Graffiti
graffiti.desc: Hand-tagged letters, a symbol, or a threat.

hazard_strip.label: Hazard Strip
hazard_strip.desc: Black-and-yellow hazard marking, faded but legible.

name: Ember Hollow Ash Fields
description: Scorched mining moon. Plasma dust, ash plains, reinforced outpost walls.

sand_rock.label: Sand Rock
sand_rock.desc: Loose rock and sand, unstable underfoot.

outpost.label: Outpost
outpost.desc: Prefab outpost decking, bolted to the rock.

ash_drift.label: Ash Drift
ash_drift.desc: Drifting ash particles in the wind.

name: Glassreef Flooded Arcology
description: Sunken city. Standing water, bioluminescent growth, crumbling transit infrastructure.

toxic.label: Toxic Pool
toxic.desc: Standing toxic water. Don't wade through it.

biolume.label: Bioluminescence
biolume.desc: Glowing biological growth on submerged surfaces.

name: Scavenger's Wake Interior
description: Cramped modular smuggler ship. Patched hull, narrow corridors, salvaged fittings.

grate.label: Grate
grate.desc: Grate flooring over the ship's cable runs.

hull.label: Hull
hull.desc: Inner hull plating, patched in several places.

hum.label: Engine Hum
hum.desc: The low vibration of the ship's drives.
